statement: This sketch creates an immersive underground cavern scene where luminescent crystals pulse with ethereal light. The crystals continuously glow with shifting colors that blend through a carefully curated palette of violet, teal, and gold hues. Each crystal has its own rhythm of pulsing light, creating a mesmerizing field of illumination that dances across the dark cave walls. When clicked, the entire color palette shifts to create a new harmonic combination of colors. The scene captures the interplay between light and shadow as the glowing crystals cast dynamic colored shadows across the rough stone surfaces, evoking the mysterious beauty of deep caverns illuminated by bioluminescent minerals.
